_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao34NZC1kp9tY4B2eRFVJz1w)_

Fixes #26553

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0050（表单布局 vs 呈现）的状态行从 Proposed 改为 Accepted，写明你在 #27032 的 A′ 裁决、裁决记录号 6464210455 和两张切换卡（#27155 spec、#27159 renderer），2026-10-20 的修订文字原样保留在裁决句之后；`docs/adr/README.md` 由 `pnpm adr:index` 重新生成（Proposed 5 → 4，Accepted 130 → 131）。
- 为什么改：你 2026-10-28 已裁 ADR-0050 接受，两张切换卡都已完成关闭，但记录和索引仍写着 Proposed；读索引的人和从这份 ADR 切卡的人读到的都是过期状态。这是 #26553 十九份记录里最后一份未收尾的。
- 风险与回滚：只改一行状态文字加生成的索引，不动任何 schema、代码或 ADR 正文；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0050-form-layout-vs-presentation.md` 第 3 行（裁决原句在前，原修订文字在后）；`docs/adr/README.md` 第 20–21 行的计数与第 123 行 ADR-0050 那一行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check`，预期打印 `adr-index: OK — docs/adr/README.md is current and every record parsed`，退出码 0。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触及 `docs/adr/**`（Tier H），席位复审后由你批准合并。

## What changes

**`docs/adr/0050-form-layout-vs-presentation.md`, line 3 only.** The status line read:

> `**Status**: Proposed (2026-06-15) · **Amended** (2026-10-20, letter B′ on #24692, ruling record 6281834942, maintainer 「同意」) — the list add-record open mode is no longer declared on `addRecord`; see the note under Decision 2.`

It now opens with the ruled sentence, verbatim from the pointer on the card (issue 26553, comment 6464456446), and keeps the amendment text after it:

> `**Status**: Accepted (2026-10-28, letter A′ on #27032, ruling record 6464210455) — cutover card #27155 (spec) + #27159 (renderer); the 2026-10-20 amendment stands · **Amended** (2026-10-20, letter B′ on #24692, ruling record 6281834942, maintainer 「同意」) — the list add-record open mode is no longer declared on `addRecord`; see the note under Decision 2.`

The amendment's links (#24692 and its ruling record) are kept, not dropped: the ruled sentence says the amendment stands, and the links are the only place the record names where that amendment was decided. Dropping them would leave a standing amendment nobody can trace (Prime Directive 13). No other line of the record asserts a Proposed state: a case-insensitive grep for `proposed` over the file hits line 3 alone before the edit and nothing after it.

**`docs/adr/README.md`** is regenerated by `node scripts/adr-index.mjs` (`pnpm adr:index`), never hand-edited: the ADR-0050 row moves from Proposed to Accepted, its date column reads the first ISO date of the new status value (2026-10-28), and the summary counts move to Accepted 131 / Proposed 4. The generator reads `Accepted` as the keyword because it is the earliest vocabulary entry in the value; the bold `Amended` sits well past the 80-character keyword window and would lose on position anyway.

**No changeset.** `docs/adr/**` ships in no released package (no `files[]` under `packages/` names `docs/adr`), so the PR publishes nothing and carries `skip-changeset`, declared on the create.

## Tests

- `node scripts/adr-index.mjs` wrote `docs/adr/README.md` (237 lines); `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` exit 0: `adr-index: OK — docs/adr/README.md is current and every record parsed`.
- `pnpm check:adr-index` exit 0 (part of the derived gates below).
- `git diff --shortstat origin/main...HEAD`: 2 files changed, 4 insertions, 4 deletions.
- The edit was applied by a script asserting exactly one hit of the old line at line 3 and exactly one hit of the new line afterwards (old hits 0, new hits 1).

## Acceptance notes

- **Neighbours.** Four open PRs touch `docs/adr/` records on their heads against their merge-base with `origin/main` `1aeeafd9`: #30828 (ADR-0142), #30862 (ADR-0125), #30899 (ADR-0146) and #30940 (ADR-0055). None of them touches `docs/adr/README.md`. Whichever of them and this PR lands later merges `main` and re-runs `pnpm adr:index` if a status line moved.
- **Claim surface held.** The record's body (Decision, Migration, Consequences) is untouched: the claim names the status line alone, and the cutover's completion is recorded by the two closed cards the line names, not by rewriting the record.
- `scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` is the gate's spelling; CI's lint ADR step calls `--report`, which warns on a stale index and never reds. The local `--check` reading above is the one that would.
